milestone.title: test coverage gap closure — autopilot_detach, breaking_release apply, archive/purge/metrics, gates G6/G14, error-path negatives

intent.outcome: Each handler and validate gate that ships in `crates/mp` has at least one direct integration test covering both happy and error paths, so a regression in any of them surfaces in CI instead of dogfood.

problem.description:
Several handler modules and validate gates have thin or zero direct coverage:
- crates/mp/src/commands/autopilot_detach.rs: zero functional tests; the M178 S3 detach-via-setsid contract is unverified (only help-text check).
- crates/mp/src/commands/breaking_release.rs:58-93 (apply arm): the `.mp/breaking_release.json` write and `anyhow::bail!` error branch are uncovered; only preflight has a test.
- crates/mp/src/commands/metrics.rs (entire file): no dedicated test file, only taxonomy / single smoke.
- crates/mp/src/commands/archive.rs: cmd_archive's list-archived / restore / purge arms not exercised (suite_milestone_archive.rs covers archive-milestone only).
- crates/mp/src/validate/plan.rs:214-232 (G6 — all-AC-passed at spec=verified): no direct unit test.
- crates/mp/src/validate/gates.rs (check_g14_approval_requests): only golden scenario covers it.
- Error paths in commands/config.rs, git.rs, archive.rs, digest.rs that bubble up via `?` have no negative integration tests.

in_scope: Add crates/mp/tests/autopilot_drive_detach.rs covering: detached child survives parent exit (setsid); state file written to v2 path; SIGTERM triggers killpg; preflight refusals return exit code 2.

Add crates/mp/tests/breaking_release_apply.rs covering: apply-after-clean-preflight writes .mp/breaking_release.json; apply-after-blocked-preflight returns exit code and the bailout message survives unchanged.
Add crates/mp/tests/suites/metrics.rs covering: MetricsCmd::Show happy path after MetricsCmd::Set (round-trip); error branch for an unknown metric field.
Extend crates/mp/tests/suites/milestone_archive.rs with restore, purge, list-archived coverage.
Add crates/mp/tests/suites/gate_g6_unit.rs and gate_g14_unit.rs: direct unit tests for the G6 (verified-with-pending-AC) and G14 (open approval requests) branches.

Add at least three negative integration tests across config.rs, git.rs, archive.rs, digest.rs covering existing `bail!`/`with_context` error branches (use mp digest --since not-a-duration as the template).
Add a CHANGELOG entry grouping the coverage gains; no behavior change.
out_of_scope: Refactoring the implementations under test — only add tests in this milestone.
Re-doing the unrelated tests that already pass.

acceptance_criteria.description: autopilot_detach.rs has at least three behavioral tests that exercise the setsid detach, state-file write, and shutdown paths.
breaking_release::apply has direct coverage of the write-marker and the bailout error branches.
metrics.rs has a dedicated suite covering Show / Set round-trip and an error branch.
archive.rs restore, purge, and list-archived arms each have at least one positive integration test.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test milestone_archive --no-fail-fast (existing plus new tests).

acceptance_criteria.description: Validate gates G6 (verified-with-pending-AC) and G14 (open approval requests) each have at least one direct unit test in a dedicated suite file.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test gate_g6_unit --no-fail-fast && cargo nextest run -p mp --test gate_g14_unit --no-fail-fast.

acceptance_criteria.description: At least three negative integration tests exist that drive existing `?`-propagated error paths in config.rs / git.rs / archive.rs / digest.rs to non-zero exits, and CI runs them.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test config_cmd_negative --no-fail-fast && cargo nextest run -p mp --test archive_negative --no-fail-fast && cargo nextest run -p mp --test digest_negative --no-fail-fast.

acceptance_criteria.description: make test remains green and the new tests do not introduce flakes.
acceptance_criteria.verification: make test (3 consecutive runs, each exit 0; if any run fails, the milestone is not verified).
